sources.title: National Policy for Digital Accessibility (March 2024)
sources.issuer: UAE Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority

excerpt.text: All public service sites must comply with Level AA of the WCAG 2.1.

expressions.authority: UAE Legislation — Ministry of Cabinet Affairs
expressions.notes: Arabic policy summary page consulted; full Arabic policy PDF not captured. No claim of equal authority with the English PDF.
uncertainties: Arabic policy page is a summary; full Arabic instrument not compared.
Which language expression is authoritative is unresolved.

provisions.heading: Scope and covered entities

locator.value: National policy: scope and general provisions

provisions.summary: The official national policy includes federal entities and public-service providers; precise contractual reach and enforcement must be interpreted with the original clauses.

provisions.heading: Staff training
provisions.summary: Article 8 discusses periodic employee training and accessible training materials.

provisions.heading: Technical references
provisions.summary: Article 9 and Annex 1 contain requirements or references to technical standards; verify specific version and exemptions before encoding.

provisions.heading: Governance and Digital Accessibility Officer
provisions.summary: The policy assigns governance responsibilities and defines a Digital Accessibility Officer role; the officer’s authority and independence are not established from the captured text.

provisions.heading: Publication, reporting and enforcement
provisions.summary: The policy requires entity policies or statements, compliance reporting and indicators; the captured English text does not state a public penalty schedule.

interpretations.statement: Scope of public service sites and whether annex language establishes a binding legal obligation need legal review.
interpretations.observation: The annex says public service sites must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA.

interpretations.statement: Whether separate built-in text-to-speech is mandatory or technology-neutral alternatives satisfy the requirement is not resolved.
interpretations.observation: A text-reader feature is explicitly described.

interpretations.statement: It is unclear which user journeys, media types and service channels require each feature.
interpretations.observation: The annex discusses sign-language and speech recognition features.

interpretations.statement: Whether the 2024 policy is a binding instrument and what enforcement follows a low compliance percentage or complaint is unresolved.
interpretations.observation: The policy defines governance, a Digital Accessibility Officer role, compliance percentages and Digital Government Enablers indicators.

interpretations.statement: The Arabic policy page and the English policy PDF have not been compared, so authoritative-language status and translation provenance remain unresolved.
interpretations.observation: The Arabic policy page and the English policy PDF are both published by official UAE sources.

target.title: UAE technical annex (same official policy PDF)

relations.note: Discovery link only; the policy and law have not been reconciled.
